title: On Justifying the expense to the elders
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：justify　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 justify 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the guide ① justified the expense to the elders with great care, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② justifies the expense to the elders on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ justify the expense to the elders at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ justified the expense to the elders before — a line in the guidebook for July 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Justifying the expense to the elders with great care, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ justify his conduct on that day on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Justify his conduct on that day at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ justifies his conduct on that day with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ justified the expense to the elders again when nobody else would.

⑩ To justify the expense to the elders, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody justifies the expense to the elders on the same day again and somebody must justify the expense to the elders with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 证明…正当（一般过去式 justified the expense to the elders：1948 年向导头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 证明…正当（一般现在 justifies the expense to the elders：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 证明…正当（不定式 to justify the expense to the elders：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 证明…正当（过去完成时 had justified the expense to the elders：1942 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 证明…正当（动名词 justifying the expense to the elders 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 为…辩解（justify his conduct on that day：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去为…辩解为他那天的举动辩解）
G. v. 为…辩解（justify his conduct on that day：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 证明…正当（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 justifies his conduct on that day，而母亲又一次 justified the expense to the elders）

answers.why: justify 意为“证明…正当”，1948 年向导小心翼翼地证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 justified。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，自那以后向导当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 justifies。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当”，此处为不定式 to justify the expense to the elders。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人证明…正当过，故用过去完成时 had justified。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，向导说“证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 justifying the expense to the elders 作主语。
justify 意为“为…辩解”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去为…辩解为他那天的举动辩解”，should ever 之后用原形 justify his conduct on that day。
justify 意为“为…辩解”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻为…辩解为他那天的举动辩解（justify his conduct on that day at once），以后再也不要提起。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例为…辩解为他那天的举动辩解，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 justifies。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当，用一般过去式 justified 叙述。
justify 意为“证明…正当”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

多年以后，向导仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（justifies the expense to the elders）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当这件事本身。（to justify the expense to the elders）
早在 1942 年就有人证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当，七月那天旅行手册上的一行字就是证据。（had justified the expense to the elders）
向导说过，小心翼翼地证明…正当向长辈说明这笔花费正当这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（justifying the expense to the elders 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻为…辩解为他那天的举动辩解，以后再也不要提起。（justify his conduct on that day，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 justify 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the guide justified the expense to the elders with great care, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide justifies the expense to the elders on the same day whenever the valley asks.
Justifying the expense to the elders with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever justify his conduct on that day on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley justifies his conduct on that day with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother justified the expense to the elders again, and the valley remembered that half.
